name: trip-forge
description: Generate thoroughly researched, executable travel plans as self-contained HTML reports.

interface.shortDescription: Generate complete, mobile-friendly HTML travel plans.
interface.longDescription: Research current travel information and create a relaxed, weather-aware, executable itinerary as a complete self-contained HTML report. Every volatile fact (prices, schedules, opening hours, weather) is cross-verified against two sources, recorded in an on-disk fact ledger, and checked by a final verification gate before delivery. Hosts with subagent dispatch additionally get parallel multi-agent research and independent quality review.
capabilities: Cross-verified fact ledger with final verification gate
defaultPrompt: Create a complete HTML travel plan for my next trip.
Research my destination and build a weather-aware itinerary.
Generate a mobile-friendly travel report with backup plans.
